values.description: Offline autograder for cs101 - student code runs in an isolated VPC with no internet access
values.name: autograder

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2

phases:
  install:
    commands:
      - echo "Autograder build container started - network egress is restricted to private VPC endpoints only (no internet access)"
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - echo "Preparing offline grading sandbox for course cs101"
      - mkdir -p grading-results
      - ls -la
  build:
    commands:
      - echo "Running grading harness for $COURSE_NAME (build $CODEBUILD_BUILD_ID)"
      - |
        if [ -f ./run_autograder.sh ]; then
          bash ./run_autograder.sh > grading-results/results.txt 2>&1 || true
        else
          echo "No run_autograder.sh found in the repository; nothing to grade." > grading-results/error.txt
        fi
      - echo "Grading finished at $(date -u)" >> grading-results/summary.txt
  post_build:
    commands:
      - echo "Uploading grading results to s3://$RESULTS_BUCKET via the S3 gateway VPC endpoint"

artifacts:
  base-directory: grading-results
  files:
    - "**/*"

values.description: Service role for the offline autograder CodeBuild project
values.name: autograder-codebuild-role

values.description: GitHub access token for the autograder CodeBuild project. Terraform writes a generated bootstrap value at apply time; rotate a real GitHub personal access token into this secret out-of-band via Secrets Manager before the first real grading run.
values.name: autograder/github-access-token

values.description: Autograder build containers - no inbound access; egress limited to the S3 gateway endpoint, VPC interface endpoints, and VPC DNS
values.name: autograder-codebuild

values.description: Allows HTTPS from autograder CodeBuild build containers into the private VPC interface endpoints
values.name: autograder-vpc-endpoints

values.description: HTTPS to the CodeBuild and CloudWatch Logs interface endpoints
HTTPS to S3 through the gateway VPC endpoint (grading results upload)
HTTPS from autograder build containers to the VPC interface endpoints
